blind_spots.blind_spot: Engineering center of gravity is offshore while the differentiated deployments are classified airgaps
blind_spots.operator_reality: Mumbai-based engineers cannot touch SIPR/JWICS installs, ITAR-adjacent telemetry, or on-site sustainment — every classified deployment lands on whatever tiny cleared US contingent exists, which becomes the single point of failure for patching, model updates, and outage response in disconnected enclaves.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The commercial platform business runs fine offshore; the structural mismatch only bites as the DoD install base grows.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: For SIPR/JWICS environments or highly restricted corporate networks, Falkonry can be deployed fully disconnected in your private cloud or on standalone hard

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Weeks, not years' delivery promise collides with accreditation timelines they never name
blind_spots.operator_reality: They cite SOC2 for cloud, but a government airgap or GovCloud install still needs RMF accreditation and an ATO on the receiving network — the calendar is owned by the DAO, not by Falkonry's deployment tooling, and the promise sets program expectations the accreditation process will break.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their compliance vocabulary is commercial (SOC2, regulatory-grade); RMF/ATO/IL levels never appear in their language.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: delivering proven, regulatory-grade intelligence in weeks, not years

blind_spots.blind_spot: No-code 'every engineer' model ownership assumes an operator population the military sustainment site doesn't have
blind_spots.operator_reality: CBM+ sites run on E-5 maintainers with 20 minutes of training, not process/reliability engineers who iterate models — in an airgapped enclave with no vendor reachback, model drift and retraining have no named owner, and the tool quietly decays into ignored alerts.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their commercial buyers (steel mills, plants) really do staff reliability engineers; the military manning model is different and their language never distinguishes it.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Democratize analytics with powerful no-code/low-code tools, enabling engineering teams to understand as well as improve their systems and operations.

opener_hook: Falkonry's deployment page offers fully disconnected SIPR/JWICS installs while both of its live software engineering requisitions sit in Mumbai — which usually means a single cleared engineer owns every classified deployment end to end.
what_they_do: No-code time-series AI platform that turns sensor and telemetry data into anomaly detection and condition monitoring, from cloud to airgapped tactical edge.
